description: Answers the open question (Rückfrage) about an ordered certificate with the customer's answers: values keyed by the item keys get_status listed, files the question asks for, and an explanation. Ask the customer first and send only what they confirmed.

documents.description: files the upload items ask for, each with the item it answers

content_base64.description: the file, base64-encoded: JPG, PNG, WebP or PDF, at most 10 MB

filename.description: the file's name, for your reference

item.description: the key of the upload item the file answers, as get_status lists it, e.g. consumption.missing; needed where several items ask for the same kind of file

kind.description: rechnung (energy bill or Heizkostenabrechnung), fassade_strasse (photo of the street side), fassade_garten, heizung (photo of the boiler or heat pump), typenschild (photo of its type plate) or sonstiges

explanation.description: what the customer wants to add or explain, e.g. why a value can't be given; in German

order_token.description: the order_token start_order returned; it opens only this order, keep it private

values.description: the answers, keyed by the item keys get_status listed; numbers with a point, e.g. 2004 or 140.5; dates as YYYY-MM-DD, months as YYYY-MM; a multiselect's option values comma-separated, keine for none; ja or nein

name: answer_inquiry
title: Answer the Energieberater's question
